scope: source-bound state-cardinality and process-policy audit before prototype

primary_source.citation: Ogden FL et al. (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method, Water Resources Research 51

source_bound_findings.water_content_discretization: The method divides theta-space into a user-chosen finite number N of bins between residual water content and effective porosity.
source_bound_findings.reported_infiltration_resolution: The paper states that approximately 150-200 bins between theta_r and theta_e are required to accurately describe infiltration-front profiles, while fewer may suffice if the minimum simulated water content stays above theta_r.
source_bound_findings.bin_constitutive_cost: K(theta) and psi(theta) are evaluated at bin edges and can be precomputed because they are constant for a fixed hydraulic material and bin definition.
water_regimes: water simultaneously connected to surface and groundwater or extending indefinitely as initial state
source_bound_findings.time_integration: The paper describes one ODE per active bin and generally uses explicit forward Euler time integration, followed by capillary relaxation.
source_bound_findings.capillary_relaxation: The published relaxation operation moves water between theta bins without REV-scale advection and is claimed to conserve mass when implemented with finite-volume transfers.
source_bound_findings.root_uptake_reference_policy: The paper removes transpiration demand from the right-most water-containing bin in the specified root zone first. This is a published FWC process policy, not automatically SWAP5 root-uptake physics.

bounded_state_assessment.interpretation: A finite theta-bin discretization bounds the base per-material/bin arrays, but this alone does not prove a hard bound on all dynamic front/slug objects under repeated forcing. SWAP5 must not infer bounded persistent state until the official implementation or an equation-level reconstruction establishes the exact representation and maximum multiplicity.

SWAP5_process_policy_separation.root_uptake: Do not inherit right-most-bin-first extraction as hidden solver physics. SWAP root uptake should remain an external conservative sink contract unless separately scientifically qualified.
SWAP5_process_policy_separation.evaporation: Accept realized or potential evaporation through the shared process/boundary contract; do not duplicate surface-process ownership inside FWC.
SWAP5_process_policy_separation.groundwater: Published groundwater-front dynamics are evidence of physical capability, not yet the SWAP5 imposed-head/imposed-flux interface contract.
SWAP5_process_policy_separation.capillary_relaxation: May remain an internal FWC state-representation operation only if its transfers are exactly ledgered, bounded in work and transaction-safe.

next_gates: inspect the official 2015 C implementation to determine exact arrays/data structures for infiltration fronts, falling slugs and groundwater fronts
prove or impose a hard maximum dynamic-state cardinality per theta bin and per soil layer without changing physical meaning
measure capillary-relaxation complexity and establish whether it is O(Nbins), O(Nbins log Nbins) or worse in the actual implementation
qualify smaller or nonuniform theta-bin layouts against the 150-200-bin reference before claiming MultiSWAP memory suitability
externalize SWAP root uptake and other shared process physics rather than copying the historical FWC process policy
